channel.title: GM Research
channel.description: Daily intelligence briefings on markets, law, AI, biohacking, trading and more.

item.title: Precedent: MiCA’s Morning After: Just 210 of 1,200+ EU Crypto Firms Cleared the Licensing Bar
item.description: Two days into full MiCA enforcement, only 17% of registered EU crypto firms hold a CASP licence, leaving 1,000 firms in breach with no extensions.

item.title: Cortex: Meituan's stealth model "Owl Alpha" revealed as open-sourced LongCat-2.0
item.description: A model quietly topping OpenRouter and Claude Code usage charts for two months turns out to be Meituan's 1.6T LongCat-2.0, trained on Chinese chips. Together AI raises $800M.

item.title: Praxis: The unit of AI progress is now the obsolete workflow, not the better tool
item.description: Mollick's new essay, METR's own benchmark data, and Anthropic's 400,000-session study converge: AI capability compounds fast enough that judgment, not technique, is what survives.

item.title: Rabbit Hole: Space destroys red blood cells 54% faster — and the damage lasts a year after landing
item.description: A 2022 Nature Medicine study overturned 60 years of assumption: hemolysis in space never stops, and nobody knows exactly why.

item.title: Morning Edge: BTC $60K Reclaim Attempt: $210M Short-Liq 0.55% Away
item.description: F&G recovers from Extreme Fear to 36. BTC near $60K with a massive $210M short-liq cluster just above. Jobs print TODAY 8:30am ET. Chip stocks bleed.

item.title: Precedent: CFTC Sues Kentucky, Its First Republican-State Prediction-Market Target
item.description: The CFTC's suit against a GOP attorney general shows federal preemption of prediction markets is now bipartisan-proof litigation, not a red-blue fight.

item.title: Cortex: Anthropic launches Claude Science; OpenAI buys Ona for persistent Codex agents
item.description: Claude Science backs 50 research projects with $30k credits each. OpenAI's Ona buyout gives Codex multi-day cloud runs as weekly users hit 5M. Cascade retires today

item.title: Biohacker: FMD activates autophagy in humans — first direct RCT evidence
item.description: 5-day FMD raises autophagic flux in immune cells (GeroScience RCT, n=30). Eccentric overload for strength, collagen + Ca + D3 for bone density, and astaxanthin's brain pathways.

item.title: Alpha: Iceberg Refresh: the reload is the tell, not the tip
item.description: A price level absorbs print after print at identical size and never runs dry — that's a hidden order reloading. Here's how to read the refresh, not just spot the iceberg.

item.title: Rabbit Hole: Sand dunes that roar: the physics of a desert phenomenon
item.description: In ~30 spots worldwide, avalanching sand locks into a shared frequency and booms at 105 dB — audible 10 km away. The mechanism took a century to explain.

item.title: Morning Edge: BTC $60K Breaks: F&G 11, Flush Risk Below $58K
item.description: Record $4B June ETF outflows, Strategy broke its never-sell rule, Fear & Greed at 11 — the squeeze thesis is dead and $58K is now the line.

item.title: Precedent: Three Jurisdictions, One Day: MiCA, AUSTRAC and California Enforcement Go Live at Once
item.description: MiCA licensing, Australia's Travel Rule and California's DFAL all become enforceable on 1 July, as a Visa-Stripe-BlackRock stablecoin coalition sends Circle shares down 17%.

item.title: Cortex: Fable 5 goes globally available as export-control suspension lifts
item.description: Fable 5 returns to global GA as Anthropic lifts its export-control suspension; Sonnet 5 defaults in Claude Code at 1M context; ITG lists on Nasdaq.

item.title: Praxis: The discomfort is not the cost of the gain — it is the mechanism producing it
item.description: Farnam Street's Brain Food and Anders Ericsson's deliberate-practice research converge: pain at the edge of ability isn't overhead on the way to skill, it's how skill is built.

item.title: Alpha: Kyle's Lambda: the price you pay per dollar of order flow
item.description: Kyle's Lambda is the regression slope turning order flow into a price-impact number — why thin books move further per dollar traded. BTC's $60K break is today's live example.

item.title: Morning Edge: BTC Quarter-End Cliffhanger: $60K Hold or Flush?
item.description: June closed with $4B+ in ETF outflows, BTC barely above $60K, shorts 51.8% of OI — squeeze thesis unresolved heading into Q3.

item.title: Precedent: MiCA Day One: Binance Out, CLARITY Act Stalls, UK PM Race Resets Crypto Agenda
item.description: MiCA's transitional period expires today, locking Binance out of the EU; the CLARITY Act faces its last credible Senate window; ASIC quietly extends Australia's no-action deadline.

item.title: Cortex: Claude lands on Azure Foundry; Mythos Preview retires today
item.description: Anthropic goes GA on NVIDIA GB300 clusters in Azure with governed inference and US data zones. GPT-5.6 leads Terminal-Bench 2.1; GLM-5.2 hits 62.1 on SWE-bench Pro at $1.40/M.

item.title: Biohacker: CGM works for prediabetes, not standalone weight loss — oral microbiome as aging clock
item.description: 2026 meta-analysis (n=1,074): CGM benefits prediabetics, not healthy normals. Oral bacteria score biological age. Rapamycin PEARL trial results. Peptide evidence hierarchy.

item.title: Alpha: Sign of Strength: Wyckoff's confirmation that markup is beginning
item.description: The SOS is a high-volume, wide-spread advance through resistance that tells you accumulation is over and the Composite Operator is moving price. Here is how to read it on BTC tape.

item.title: Rabbit Hole: The crystal that cannot exist — and the golden ratio hiding inside it
item.description: Quasicrystals have fivefold symmetry that classical crystallography said was impossible. Their atomic spacing is governed by an irrational number.

item.title: Morning Edge: BTC funding flips negative below $60K — squeeze thesis reversed, shorts now 1.55:1
item.description: Funding rate hit −0.66% annualised overnight as OI shed $74M and short imbalance hit 1.55:1. The $60,940 squeeze is off the table; liq map now targets $59,080.

item.title: Precedent: Binance Locked Out of Europe as MiCA's Hard Deadline Bites
item.description: Binance suspends EU services after failing to secure a MiCA licence; CME sues the CFTC over perps; CLARITY Act ethics talks collapse with 31 Senate days left.

item.title: Cortex: GPT-5.6 Sol previewed — 91.9% TerminalBench; Fable 5 export hold partially lifted
item.description: GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna in limited preview; Sol Ultra tops public models on agentic coding. US restores ~100-org access to Anthropic Fable 5. Claude Code Dynamic Workflows now GA.

item.title: Praxis: The frame is the leverage: experts, odds, and constraints reveal what you can't see
item.description: Cedric Chin, Ted Lamade, and James Clear independently converge on the same insight: the frame you apply to a situation determines what moves become visible.

item.title: Alpha: Order Flow Imbalance: the limit-order signal that leads price by a tick
item.description: OFI tracks net pressure from every bid add, cancel, and execution — not just trades. The leading signal CVD can't show, rooted in Cont, Kukanov & Stoikov's 2014 paper.

item.title: Rabbit Hole: Erasing a bit generates heat — and it's a law of physics, not a design flaw
item.description: In 1961 Rolf Landauer proved information is physical: erasing one bit must release heat. Modern chips exceed the limit by a billion times.

item.title: Morning Edge: BTC squeezes above $60K but AI selloff hangover keeps bulls on defence
item.description: Short liq map stacked at $60,940 keeps the squeeze risk alive, but Nikkei −4.2%, NDX −1.1% and Fear & Greed at 36 say macro is the headwind today.

item.title: Precedent: Trump holds CBDC ban hostage — and the stablecoin clock keeps ticking
item.description: Trump refuses to sign the housing bill's four-year Fed CBDC ban, conditioning his signature on a voter-ID bill the Senate already rejected — July 18 GENIUS Act deadline closing in.

item.title: Cortex: GPT-5.6 Sol launches limited preview — 91.9% Terminal-Bench, Fable 5 still frozen
item.description: OpenAI debuts Sol/Terra/Luna to ~20 partners. Anthropic files S-1 at $965B valuation, $47B ARR. Claude Code gets 5-level hierarchical agents. Grass GRASS +9.6%.

item.title: Biohacker: NAD+ precursors confirmed, cold immersion dosed, TRE quantified
item.description: Nature Metabolism RCT pins NMN/NR mechanism via gut microbiome; partial CWI equals whole-body for DOMS; 23-RCT TRE meta-analysis gives real effect sizes on glucose and HDL.

item.title: Alpha: Delta Divergence: when price lies and the tape tells the truth
item.description: Price makes a new high but cumulative delta is flat or falling — aggressive buyers have already stopped. Delta divergence is one of the cleanest exhaustion reads in orderflow.

item.title: Morning Edge: AI Selloff Sinks Nikkei 4.2% as BTC Stalls at $60K Short-Squeeze Line
item.description: OpenAI IPO delay reprices global AI premium; BTC $174M short cluster at $60,860; SOL +9.2% leads crypto rotation. GENIUS Act rules due July 18.

item.title: Precedent: MiCA's transition ends 1 July: ESMA orders unlicensed CASPs to wind down
item.description: Four days to the hard deadline, ESMA tells unauthorised crypto firms to stop onboarding and exit the EU — and Binance pulls its Greek licence bid.

item.title: Cortex: Fable 5 & Mythos 5 frozen by US export-control order — Opus 4.8 is the usable ceiling
item.description: US export-control order froze Anthropic's two best models 3 days after launch; GPT-4.5 retires from ChatGPT today; AI×crypto basket bleeds — TAO $213, RENDER $1.54, AKT $0.64.

item.title: Praxis: The difficulty dividend: why friction is the skill, not the obstacle
item.description: As AI strips effort from thinking, learning science says the effort was the mechanism — durable skill and original voice are forged in the friction the tools remove.

item.title: Alpha: VWAP: the volume-weighted mean every execution algo is built to beat
item.description: VWAP is cumulative value traded ÷ cumulative volume — the fair-value line institutions execute against. Trade its side, fade its bands, anchor it to every swing.

item.title: Rabbit Hole: The Osaka merchants who invented the futures market 300 years before Wall Street
item.description: In 1697, Osaka merchants invented the world's first futures contracts to manage rice price risk — by 1750, virtual rice volume was four times Japan's actual harvest.

item.title: Morning Edge: Macro calm spread, but BTC still cannot reclaim value
item.description: Oil and vol kept easing, yet BTC stayed pinned below weekly value near $60.9k. Morning Edge remains defensive until crypto reclaims the $62.28k-$63.23k supply band.

item.title: Precedent: Australia turns crypto compliance into a deadline business
item.description: ASIC's 30 June licensing warning and its Block Earner High Court win sharpened the message: crypto products that look like financial services will be regulated like them.

item.title: Cortex: Control planes, not model names, are driving the AI tape
item.description: OpenAI's cyber access tiers, Nvidia's AgentPerf benchmark, and Hugging Face's tooling-first open-model story all point to the same shift: deployability is outrunning model theater.

item.title: Praxis: AI makes agency more valuable, not less
item.description: Cate Hall, Cedric Chin, and Ethan Mollick converge on one move: as execution gets cheaper, the edge shifts to noticing options, making sense of ambiguity, and setting better constraints.

item.title: Alpha: Queue position is where your resting limit order sits in the first-in-first-out line at...
item.description: Place your level and hold it — every re-quote sends you to the back of the line, and a suspiciously fast passive fill usually means informed flow is about to run you over.

item.title: Rabbit Hole: The placebo can work even when you know it's fake
item.description: The surprising part is not that belief changes symptoms. It is that ritual, expectation, and conditioning can still move the body even after the deception has been removed.

item.title: Morning Edge: Oil unwind helps macro, but BTC still trades like fragile risk
item.description: WTI eased as Hormuz traffic normalized, yet crypto failed to catch the bounce; Morning Edge stays cautious until BTC reclaims the $63k-$64k supply band.

item.title: Precedent: CFTC draws a hard line on event-contract preemption
item.description: The agency sued Kentucky, reopened the 24/7 market-structure debate, and left crypto lawyers with a cleaner read on where federal derivatives power is expanding.

item.title: Cortex: Safety tooling, not model theater, led today’s AI tape
item.description: OpenAI turned pre-release simulation and cyber workflow into product, while Nvidia’s AgentPerf win kept infrastructure in the lead over pure frontier hype.

item.title: Biohacker: Protein dose and strength volume still beat fancier recovery hacks
item.description: Cell-type aging biomarkers improved, but the practical edge stayed simple: enough weekly strength work and enough protein still beat supplement theater.

item.title: Alpha: Microprice weights the book, not just the last trade
item.description: When bids and asks are uneven, the midpoint lies to you. Microprice adjusts the fair value toward the thinner side of the book and is often the cleanest next-tick read in choppy tape.

item.title: Rabbit Hole: The longitude prize was won by a carpenter, not an astronomer
item.description: Britain spent decades trying to solve navigation with sky math, then John Harrison solved it with a clock accurate enough to drag Greenwich onto the open ocean.
